Summarise an event graph

Source: R/event-graph.R
summary.dynet_event_graph.Rd

Summarise an event graph

Usage

# S3 method for class 'dynet_event_graph'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

An event graph returned by event_graph().

...

Ignored.

Value

A plain data.frame, one row per event: event, its start time, in_degree (the distinct events it follows), out_degree (the distinct events that follow it), and mean_wait, the mean wait before those successors start. mean_wait is NA for an event with no successor, where no wait is defined.

Examples

dn <- dynet(school_contacts)
summary(event_graph(dn, delta = 1))
